frontier.absorbed_part: all nonzero phases whose signed representative satisfies |gamma|<=max J
frontier.remaining_obstruction: for interior c, the integer branch range can be O(U), so a plain per-branch divisor sum is too weak
frontier.why_pointwise_guard_is_retired: a global pointwise target is stronger than required; the proof only needs high-spectrum energy control
frontier.why_this_is_progress: the near-zero and near-P phases no longer need incidence or BG machinery

lift_ledger.divisor_count: for each k, the number of pairs is <= tau(|gamma^2+kP|)
lift_ledger.dyadic_collar_model: J=[A,A+N] with U=max J and U<=P^(1/2)log^236(P)
lift_ledger.finite_transition: explicit small-P constants remain in the existing finite/P0 verification lane
lift_ledger.signed_phase_scope: take the signed representative gamma of c with |gamma|<=U
lift_ledger.sublinear_consequence: r_gamma<=log^O(P) P^o(1)=N^o(1), hence below N^(1-eta) for every fixed eta<1 and large P

plain_conclusion: shifted product fiber 的当前剩余可先按相位的有符号代表拆开。当 `|gamma|<=max J` 时，方程 `ab-gamma(a+b)=kP` 只有 `log^O(P)` 个整数分支，每个分支化为一个普通除数计数 `(a-gamma)(b-gamma)=gamma^2+kP`，因此该部分只有 `N^o(1)` 点态质量，不能进入固定幂高谱。真正剩余被压缩为内部相位 `min(c,P-c)>max J` 的平均型高谱排斥。

rows.meaning: 上一证书已把非零 PGL2 剩余改写为 shifted product fiber 高谱。
`|gamma|<=max J` 时整数分支数只有 `log^O(P)`，每分支由除数界给 `P^o(1)`。
小有符号相位满足 `r_gamma=N^o(1)`，不会进入任何固定幂高谱层。
全体 `c` 的点态次线性界足够但非必要；当前只保留高谱能量所需输入。
内部相位 `min(c,P-c)>max J` 仍需平均型分支/斜率 incidence 或除数包估计。
本步只吸收有符号小相位并精确缩窄剩余；未证明内部相位高谱排斥。
